rules::WFP Workforce Cost.rules:
SKIPCHECK;

# ===== Reporting-currency translation (precedes local rules) =====
# WFP Workforce Cost dims: Period, Version, Entity, Cost Centre, Pay Component, Currency, Position, Measure
['Reporting', 'Base'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'Employer Payroll Tax'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'Employer Pension'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'Benefits'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Benefits', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Benefits', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Benefits', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'Bonus'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Bonus', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Bonus', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Bonus', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'One-Time'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'One-Time', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'One-Time', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'One-Time', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'Gross Pay'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Gross Pay', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Gross Pay', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Gross Pay', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'Employee Income Tax'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employee Income Tax', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employee Income Tax', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employee Income Tax', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'Employee Pension'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employee Pension', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employee Pension', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employee Pension', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

['Reporting', 'Net Pay'] = N:
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Net Pay', 'GBP', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'GBP', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Net Pay', 'USD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'USD', 'Average', 'Rate')
+ DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Net Pay', 'NZD', !WFP Position, 'Amount') * DB('WFP FX Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, 'NZD', 'Average', 'Rate');

# ===== Helpers =====
['_Start Index'] = N: ATTRN('WFP Period', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Start Period'), 'Period Index');

['_End Index'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'End Period') @= '', 999, ATTRN('WFP Period', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'End Period'), 'Period Index'));

['_In Window'] = N: IF(ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') >= ['_Start Index'] & ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') <= ['_End Index'], 1, 0);

['_Start Frac'] = N:
  IF(ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') = ['_Start Index'],
     (ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Days In Month') - ATTRN('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Start Day') + 1) / ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Days In Month'), 1);

['_End Frac'] = N:
  IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'End Period') @<> '' & ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index') = ['_End Index'],
     ATTRN('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'End Day') / ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Days In Month'), 1);

['_Active Fraction'] = N: ['_In Window'] * ['_Start Frac'] * ['_End Frac'];

['_Annual Salary'] = N:
  IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Position Status') @= 'Filled' & DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Base Salary') > 0,
     DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'Base Salary'),
     DB('WFP Pay Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Grade'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Job Family'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Location'), 'Salary Mid'));

['_Monthly Base Full'] = N:
  IF(!WFP Currency @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency') & !WFP Entity @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity') & !WFP Cost Centre @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
     ['_Annual Salary'] / 12 * DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'FTE'), 0);

['_Earnings YTD'] = N:
  ['Base']
  + IF(SUBST(!WFP Period, 6, 2) @= '01', 0, DB('WFP Workforce Cost', ATTRS('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Prior Period'), !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, '_Earnings YTD', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount'));

['_Employer Tax YTD'] = N:
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 1', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 1', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 1', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 2', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 2', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 2', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 3', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 3', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 3', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 4', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 4', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 4', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 5', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 5', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 5', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 6', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 6', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 6', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 7', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 7', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Band 7', 'Rate');

['_Prior Employer Tax YTD'] = N: IF(SUBST(!WFP Period, 6, 2) @= '01', 0, DB('WFP Workforce Cost', ATTRS('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Prior Period'), !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, '_Employer Tax YTD', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount'));

['_Employee Tax YTD'] = N:
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 1', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 1', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 1', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 2', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 2', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 2', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 3', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 3', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 3', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 4', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 4', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 4', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 5', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 5', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 5', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 6', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 6', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 6', 'Rate')
  +
  MAX(0, MIN(['_Earnings YTD'], DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 7', 'Threshold To')) - DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 7', 'Threshold From')) * DB('WFP Tax Bands', ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Tax Jurisdiction'), 'Employee Income Tax', 'Band 7', 'Rate');

['_Prior Employee Tax YTD'] = N: IF(SUBST(!WFP Period, 6, 2) @= '01', 0, DB('WFP Workforce Cost', ATTRS('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Prior Period'), !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, '_Employee Tax YTD', !WFP Currency, !WFP Position, 'Amount'));

# ===== Components (local currency) =====
['Base'] = N: ['_Monthly Base Full'] * ['_Active Fraction'];

['Gross Pay'] = N: ['Base'];

['Employer Payroll Tax'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0, ['_Employer Tax YTD'] - ['_Prior Employer Tax YTD']);

['Employer Pension'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0, ['Base'] * DB('WFP Pay Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Grade'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Job Family'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Location'), 'Pension Pct'));

['Employee Income Tax'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0, ['_Employee Tax YTD'] - ['_Prior Employee Tax YTD']);

['Employee Pension'] = N: IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0, ['Base'] * DB('WFP Pay Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Grade'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Job Family'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Location'), 'Employee Pension Pct'));

['Benefits'] = N:
  IF(['_Monthly Base Full'] = 0, 0,
  IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0,
     DB('WFP Pay Rates', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Grade'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Job Family'), ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Location'), 'Benefits Annual') / 12 * DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'FTE') * ['_Active Fraction']));

['Bonus'] = N:
  IF(ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Employment Type') @= 'Contractor', 0,
     ['Base'] * DB('WFP Assumptions', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, 'Bonus Pool %'));

['One-Time'] = N:
  IF(!WFP Currency @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency')
     & !WFP Entity @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity')
     & !WFP Cost Centre @= ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
     DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Position, 'One-Time Amount'), 0);

['Net Pay'] = N: ['Gross Pay'] - ['Employee Deductions'];

FEEDERS;

['_Monthly Base Full'] => ['Base'], ['Gross Pay'], ['Employer Payroll Tax'], ['Employer Pension'], ['Benefits'], ['Bonus'], ['One-Time'],
  ['Employee Income Tax'], ['Employee Pension'], ['Net Pay'],
  ['_Earnings YTD'], ['_Employer Tax YTD'], ['_Prior Employer Tax YTD'], ['_Employee Tax YTD'], ['_Prior Employee Tax YTD'];

['_Monthly Base Full'] =>
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Base', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Gross Pay', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Payroll Tax', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employer Pension', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Benefits', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Bonus', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'One-Time', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employee Income Tax', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Employee Pension', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount'),
  DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version, !WFP Entity, !WFP Cost Centre, 'Net Pay', 'Reporting', !WFP Position, 'Amount');

rules::WFP Workforce Input.rules:
SKIPCHECK;

# Phase 3.5 — encapsulated calculating versions.
# Budget / Forecast / Downside each carry their OWN seeded input (FTE, Base
# Salary, One-Time Amount) written by WFP Seed Workforce Input from that version's
# own assumptions. The only cross-version read is prior-period Actual: for
# Forecast and Downside, CLOSED months (Period Index <= that version's Actuals
# Cutoff Index, read at the position's Home Entity) are overridden with the
# Actual version. STET on the open side leaves the seeded input untouched.
# Frozen snapshot versions (FCST YYYY-MM, Budget FINAL) have no rule here — their
# input cells are written directly by WFP Snapshot Version.

['Forecast'] = N:
  IF( ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index')
        <= DB('WFP Assumptions', !WFP Period, 'Forecast',
               ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'), 'Actuals Cutoff Index'),
      DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Input Measure),
      STET );

['Downside'] = N:
  IF( ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index')
        <= DB('WFP Assumptions', !WFP Period, 'Downside',
               ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'), 'Actuals Cutoff Index'),
      DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Input Measure),
      STET );

FEEDERS;

# Every version whose FTE is a real cell (seeded Budget/Forecast/Downside/Actual,
# or a snapshot copy) feeds its own Workforce Cost entry point + Headcount.
['FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version,
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');
['FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, !WFP Version,
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');

# Closed-month Forecast / Downside resolve to Actual via the rule above, so
# Actual's FTE also feeds those two versions' downstream cells.
['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Forecast',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');
['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, 'Forecast',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');
['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Downside',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');
['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, 'Downside',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');

SKIPCHECK;

# Phase 3.5 — encapsulated calculating versions.
# Budget / Forecast / Downside each carry their OWN seeded input (FTE, Base
# Salary, One-Time Amount) written by WFP Seed Workforce Input from that version's
# own assumptions. The only cross-version read is prior-period Actual: for
# Forecast and Downside, CLOSED months (Period Index <= that version's Actuals
# Cutoff Index, read at the position's Home Entity) are overridden with the
# Actual version. STET on the open side leaves the seeded input untouched.
# Frozen snapshot versions (FCST YYYY-MM, Budget FINAL) have no rule here — their
# input cells are written directly by WFP Snapshot Version.

[] = N: IF(ELPAR('WFP Version', !WFP Version, 1) @= 'Non-Calculating', STET, CONTINUE);

['Forecast'] = N:
  IF( ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index')
        <= DB('WFP Assumptions', !WFP Period, 'Forecast',
               ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'), 'Actuals Cutoff Index'),
      DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Input Measure),
      STET );

['Downside'] = N:
  IF( ATTRN('WFP Period', !WFP Period, 'Period Index')
        <= DB('WFP Assumptions', !WFP Period, 'Downside',
               ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'), 'Actuals Cutoff Index'),
      DB('WFP Workforce Input', !WFP Period, 'Actual', !WFP Position, !WFP Workforce Input Measure),
      STET );

FEEDERS;

# Every version whose FTE is a real cell (seeded Budget/Forecast/Downside/Actual,
# or a snapshot copy) feeds its own Workforce Cost entry point + Headcount.
['FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, !WFP Version,
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');
['FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, !WFP Version,
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');

# Closed-month Forecast / Downside resolve to Actual via the rule above, so
# Actual's FTE also feeds those two versions' downstream cells.
['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Forecast',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');
['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, 'Forecast',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');
['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Workforce Cost', !WFP Period, 'Downside',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  '_Monthly Base Full',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Salary Currency'),
  !WFP Position, 'Amount');
['Actual', 'FTE'] => DB('WFP Headcount', !WFP Period, 'Downside',
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Home Entity'),
  ATTRS('WFP Position', !WFP Position, 'Cost Centre'),
  !WFP Position, 'Headcount');
